FrilansPanel.JobberFremdelesSomFrilans.R: Why do we need to know whether you are still a freelancer?

Whether you are still active as a freelancer affects how your parental benefit is calculated. If you currently have one or more active freelance assignments, answer “Yes” here. Otherwise, enter the last day you worked as a freelancer.

The start date must be a valid date on the format dd.mm.yyyy.
